title: Camden Town Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical facilities, walk-in centres, local hazards, and supply points for Camden Town.
content:
For life-threatening medical emergencies, dial 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- University College Hospital (UCH): 235 Euston Road, London NW1 2BU. From Camden Town station: ~20 min walk south along Camden High Street and Hampstead Road (approx. 1 mile), or bus 24, 29, or 134 south towards Warren Street.
- Royal Free Hospital: Pond Street, London NW3 2QG. From Chalk Farm station: ~20 min walk north along Haverstock Hill (approx. 1 mile), or bus 24 or 168 towards Hampstead Heath. (Major Trauma Centre for North London is St Mary's Hospital, Praed Street, W2 1NY).

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- University College Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Ground Floor, 235 Euston Road, NW1 2BU. From Mornington Crescent station: ~10 min walk south along Hampstead Road.
- Royal Free Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Ground Floor, Pond Street, NW3 2QG. From Camden Road station: bus 29 or Overground to Gospel Oak, then ~10 min walk west.

3. Local Hazard Notes:
- The Regent's Canal passes directly through Camden Town under Camden High Street and Chalk Farm Road; low-lying towpaths, locks, and adjacent basements are subject to surface water pooling during severe downpours.

4. Essential Supplies:
- Pharmacies and major supermarkets along Camden High Street, Chalk Farm Road, and Parkway supply bottled water, basic first-aid equipment, and over-the-counter medicines.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
